deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 to one Bioscience Home Area.

also.quote: Deadline | December 1 | Application Fee | $135 US, $155 International

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for all Home Areas.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are now optional for all Home Areas.

english_waiver.value: Only degrees from countries where English is both the primary spoken language of daily life and the medium of instruction are exempt, so an Indian degree does not waive TOEFL/IELTS.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who hold a Bachelor’s or higher degree from a university located in the United States or in another country in which English is both the primary spoken language of daily life (e.g., Australia, Barbados, Canada, Ireland, Jamaica, New Zealand, United Kingdom) and the medium of instruction

supervisor.value: Students do quarter-long lab rotations in the first year and then choose a dissertation advisor.
supervisor.quote: In the first year, students engage in quarter-long research rotations in different laboratories to gain research experience and identify a faculty member to serve as the advisor for dissertation research.

funding.value: All students making timely progress get a stipend, full tuition, health insurance and fees.
funding.quote: All students making timely progress toward their degrees receive financial support that includes a competitive stipend, full tuition, health insurance, and various student services fees

entry_route.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

notes: Consortium of Home Areas (e.g. Molecular Biology, Human Genetics, Molecular & Medical Pharmacology, Physiology, Bioinformatics); applicants choose one Home Area. MCDB faculty recommend applying through a Home Area. Neuroscience has its own record.
name: Graduate Programs in Bioscience (Home Areas)
